'''Hydro Mining Rig''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A mining rig for digging up various types of ore such as Cuprium Ore. This rig does not need power as it can be driven with Clean Water.|The Endfield Hydro Mining Rig features a special coating to minimize the risk of rusting in humid/wet environments.}}
==Usage==
A mining rig for digging up various types of ore such as [[Cuprium Ore]].
*This rig does not need power as it can be driven with [[Clean Water]].

==Acquisition==
Requirement : [[AIC Factory Plan#Wuling AIC Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC II - Hydro Mining]]
